newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia aims at growth, investment - Chernomyrdin.
newsitem.headline: Russia aims at growth, investment - Chernomyrdin.

text.p: The main tasks of the new Russian government are to bring about economic growth and revive investment, Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin told a news conference.
"This is the task already for the current year," Chernomyrdin said, stressing the need to begin radical structural reforms among companies, natural monopolies, housing and welfare.
He said a new approach to budget and tax policy was also needed.
"Without changes in the tax system we will not be able to consider a budget for 1998," the premier said.
He was speaking flanked by his two reformist new first deputies, Anatoly Chubais and Boris Nemtsov, following a meeting with President Boris Yeltsin on the way ahead for his new government.
